title: VerificationPlan
description: Structured, deterministic risk- and impact-based verification plan defining 3-tier execution selection, skipped check audits, and conservative escalation triggers.

feature_slug.description: Unique slug identifier for the feature under plan

slice_id.description: Target vertical slice identifier if scoped to a slice

escalation_tier.description: Determined execution tier: TIER_1 (Slice-Local), TIER_2 (Affected-Feature), or TIER_3 (Full-Suite & Gatekeeper)

diff_files.description: Array of modified file paths evaluated against the trigger matrix

selected_checks.description: Array of verification checks and commands selected for execution

command.description: Executable shell command or test invocation

rationale.description: Substantive rationale explaining why this check is required

rationale_token.description: Classification token for the check rationale

category.description: Functional category of the verification check

skipped_checks.description: Audit array of skipped check suites with mandatory rule citations and substantive justification

suite_name.description: Name or identifier of the bypassed test suite

reason_code.description: Standardized reason code citing the bypass rule

reason_description.description: Substantive justification prose explaining why bypassing is safe and compliant with policy

warnings.description: Array of warnings emitted during evaluation (e.g. unmapped diff conservative escalation warnings)

mandatory_gatekeeper.description: Whether Tier 3 execution is mandatory due to Stage 5 delivery exit gating

generated_at.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp of plan generation
